verdict.rationale: Parsec is a SaaS remote-desktop service with accounts, team administration and audit logs, so data residency is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents choosing a storage region. The peer-to-peer connection claim and the enterprise relay inside your firewall concern how network traffic is routed, not where data is stored, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
